entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Player Companion: Heroes of Golarion
entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your faith and the power of flame allows you to lace fire with holy power and burn things that normally can’t be burned.

Prerequisite(s): Goblin, worshipper of a sun or fire-related deity.

Benefit(s): Whenever you make an attack or cast a spell that deals fire damage, the fire damage applies to incorporeal creatures, regardless of whether the fire is magical. An incorporeal creature’s 50% reduction in damage from corporeal sources does not apply to any fire damage that you deal.
